scope: Synthetic fixtures, actual compiled bundles, 90 independent desktop Node/V8 processes. Not Loon/iPhone or VPN memory acceptance.
method: Five fresh processes per version/case; alternated order; fixed clock/random; one invocation per process; GC before measurement. peakRSSKiB is whole-process lifetime high-water RSS, including Node/fixture setup. Heap/ArrayBuffer growth is sampled at store writes and completion, not a continuous peak. Explicit array allocation counts exclude native encoders, internal views and host buffers. All outputs and persisted records are byte-compared by SHA-256.
